how: Members repeatedly recruit builders and defenders for particular squid marks.
A member directly joins the green-squid call with a bare declaration of arrival.
A proposed larger work prompts explicit doubt about having enough hands for its initial push.
A located squid proposal gathers a participant who commits to building alongside its proposer.
Members revise the proposed object, colours, scale, and logo variants as circumstances change.
Builders report outlines started, an orange squid completed, and a later attempt stalled.
An anchor coordinate and a subsequent colour instruction make a purple-squid proposal actionable.
Locally, community-run work includes a deliberate proposal-and-relay division of responsibility without establishing command or testing the cross-room frequency claim.
The coded border-maintenance passage does not identify scripts, so the earlier case's automation report cannot establish machine placement through these concepts.
Members guard existing marks, prioritise which squid to save, and call defenders back under renewed attack.
A participant disowns persistent border maintenance as the work of rogue users without tracing individual accounts.
Neighbours propose overlap negotiations, invoke agreements, and explicitly withdraw a truce after reported destruction.
Members carry the overlap problem to another subreddit and greet neighbours on the room's behalf.
Personal assent explicitly declines to bind unseen placers, and persistent border maintainers expose that limitation in practice.
Access to a diplomacy channel depends on recognised moderator status, blocking an ordinary member's proposed negotiation.
Members propose asking a larger mark's hosts for space subject to the hosts' pink-art condition, without establishing admission or completion.
Attempted diplomacy and a promise of neighbour help do not establish a completed coalition or joint defensive organisation.
Members leave space for neighbouring work and explicitly say they had no plan to harm a peaceful arrival.
Members propose helping neighbours when repairs allow and promise future help in response to a peaceful visitor.
Members give a lost blue squid up while proposing a purple replacement and ask where to relocate the banner.
Members carry Splatoon lore and game modes into their descriptions of building and defending the canvas.
Fictional Octarian comparisons and a canvas truce do not establish a pre-existing quarrel with an actual neighbouring community.
The game analogy names fictional enemies while the Starry Night grievance concerns canvas destruction, leaving inherited ties naming an attack target unobserved.
Judd restyling and fake cancellation news establish a separate April Fools strand alongside practical canvas work.
A participant argues the canvas's worth by defending community effort, Reddit presence, and the value of helping one another.
Participants propose a fresh text thread to keep project information accurate and updateable.
A current-information thread proposal does not establish adopted megathread rules, and moderator relay does not establish control over the build.
Accomplishment titles and thanks publicly mark squid builds as collective achievements.
Reflection on working together also occurs during challenged defence of an unfinished effort, without requiring final completion.
Members report engulfing, mourn lost orange work, and later confirm that a proposed design was not made.
The final noncompletion report supplies no evidence about carrying the temporary effort into a later purpose.
The post-event negative answer concerns whether a design was made and leaves disputes about cleaned copies or historical accounts unobserved.
Declaring a truce off and calling for defence do not establish an outward attack call or its execution.
An accusation of destruction ending a truce does not establish an extended rival exchange of taunts or victory claims.
Calls may first elicit design revision or instruction requests, and a willing response does not ensure completed work.
A starter's located proposal already incorporates the call for helpers, showing that the two acts can coincide.
Protection can become necessary during an unfinished build when another placer repeatedly overwrites its emerging shape.
The same speaker answers an invading-flag problem by reporting contact with the flag makers' subreddit.
Agreements supply reasons for restraint but cannot turn one participant's consent into compliance by unseen or dissenting placers.
The concepts do not establish script adoption or show that timer-limited repair capacity caused it.
Participants celebrate work they report as made and directly thank its helpers.
Celebration precedes reported loss here, but the record does not show that marking the work caused archival preservation.
A negative report after placement ends supplies no observed transition from recording to a new collective purpose.
Doubt about launching an additional build does not establish capacity shortage causing abandonment of an existing spot or relocation.
A proposal becomes an anchor coordinate and colour instruction without evidence that an agreed pixel template settled a design dispute.
Bare joining is evidenced, but willingness may include a request for instructions and a call may receive a counterproposal.
The explicit upkeep-help connection proposes sending spare repair labour outward, without demonstrating shortage causing incoming help.
A peaceful visitor receives an offer of help, but neither completed reciprocal placing nor a settled border causing it is observed.
Recruitment and defensive appeals are observed without an established ensuing outward attack call.
Restraint is evidenced without an established local attack-call episode from which its response mechanism could be tested.
Invoking a peace treaty during defence does not establish negotiation as a response to the room's own outward attack call.
A reported broken truce supplies neither an established local attack call nor a subsequent rival-taunting exchange.
A blocked diplomacy attempt and proposed neighbour help do not establish coalition formation caused by maintenance pressure.
Defending canvas participation's worth is observed, but a flood causing posting restrictions or a designated megathread is not established.
A border request directly elicits personal consent qualified by inability to speak for other placers.

statement: Explaining the canvas remains a distinct practice during ongoing work.
how: The ladder names explanation but the standing process list needs to retain a late answer explaining what the canvas is.
Celebrating and thanking helpers immediately renews construction when the same participant calls for another squid and later reports its outline started.
A single report gives one squid up while proposing its replacement, preserving selective loss within continued coordination.
